# Alchemy Media | 炼金传媒

> Alchemy Media supports independent artists and record labels with China-to-global and global-to-China music services. 炼金传媒为独立音乐人与唱片厂牌提供中国与海外双向音乐服务。

## About

Alchemy Media was established in China in 2017 and supports independent artists and record labels across promotion, distribution and music-business services.
炼金传媒于2017年在中国成立，服务独立音乐人与唱片厂牌，涵盖宣发、发行及音乐事业支持。

## Services

- [Cross-border promotion](https://www.alchemymedia.cn/#cross-border-promotion) / [跨境宣发](https://www.alchemymedia.cn/zh/#cross-border-promotion) — Promotion between China and overseas markets. / 协助中国音乐走向海外，也帮助海外音乐进入中国市场。
- [Digital music distribution](https://www.alchemymedia.cn/#digital-distribution) / [数字音乐发行](https://www.alchemymedia.cn/zh/#digital-distribution) — Global and regional streaming delivery, metadata and royalty collection support. / 提供全球数字发行、元数据与版税征收支持。
- [Physical record distribution](https://www.alchemymedia.cn/#physical-distribution) / [实体唱片分销](https://www.alchemymedia.cn/zh/#physical-distribution) — Distribution logistics for vinyl, CDs and cassettes. / 提供黑胶唱片、CD和磁带分销物流。
- [Merchandise production](https://www.alchemymedia.cn/#merchandise) / [创意周边生产](https://www.alchemymedia.cn/zh/#merchandise) — Production coordination for apparel, accessories and custom merchandise. / 协调服饰、配饰和定制周边生产。
- [Art direction and visual design](https://www.alchemymedia.cn/#visual-design) / [艺术指导与视觉设计](https://www.alchemymedia.cn/zh/#visual-design) — Visual design for music releases, touring and label identities. / 为音乐发行、巡演宣传和厂牌品牌提供视觉设计。
- [Live booking and touring](https://www.alchemymedia.cn/#live-booking) / [演出经纪与巡演](https://www.alchemymedia.cn/zh/#live-booking) — Booking and touring coordination for independent artists. / 协调独立音乐人的演出预订与巡演。
- [Career and label management](https://www.alchemymedia.cn/#label-management) / [艺人规划与厂牌托管](https://www.alchemymedia.cn/zh/#label-management) — Career planning, release scheduling and operational support. / 提供职业规划、发行排期与运营支持。
